newsitem.title: LEBANON: Bank of Beirut 1996 unaudited results.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Beirut 1996 unaudited results.

text.p: Bank of Beirut reported on Saturday big increases in its assets, customer deposits and profits in 1996.
Net income rose to 7.99 billion Lebanese pounds from 4.31 billion in 1995, the bank said in its unaudited balance sheet published in Beirut newspapers.
Bank of Beirut, which ranked 17th among Lebanon's 82 banks in size of customer deposits in 1995, said its assets rose to 717.8 billion pounds from 452 billion in 1995.

According to the Almanac of Lebanese banks, Bank of Beirut is owned by nine Lebanese investors, Saudi Prince Mohammad Bin al-Saoud and the Luxembourg-based holding company International Century Corporation.
It has 102 employees and six branches in Lebanon.
